summary: Phase 3.2 — Value Formatters + Sliding-Window Rate Limit. 16/21 functional pytest cases PASSED on a single run; remaining 5 are SKIPPED due to CoinGecko upstream 429 (not code bugs — spec explicitly allows this). Across two runs every backend behaviour in the request has been validated: direct-module formatter math (8/8 cases incl. currency / percent ± colour / compact / relative_time / casing / dict-skip-none), direct-module sliding-window (3 allowed → 4th denied with retry_after≥1 → 2.2s sleep → recovered with remaining=2), X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset headers present and Remaining DECREMENTS on second call, structured response_map + formatters on /admin/widgets/test-api against live CoinGecko ('$62,808.00' + '-x.xx%' coloured), editor_config rejects formatters/item_formatters that aren't dicts (400), from-template live_crypto ships formatters and api-call returns mapped_formatted.value.formatted starting with '$', from-template live_crypto_markets ships item_formatters and api-call returns mapped_arrays_formatted.items[*].value.formatted = currency, .body.formatted = uppercase symbol, admin analytics endpoint ACL (stealth=200, support=200, tfone=403) + complete response shape (window_hours/total_429s/top_keys/top_users/top_ips/top_endpoints), Phase 3.1 regression (no formatters → mapped present + mapped_formatted={}). Structured 429 detail shape skipped because we always hit CoinGecko upstream 429 before our local 60/min sliding window — spec marks this code-review acceptable.

minor.issue: If `editor_config.layout` is sent as an OBJECT (e.g. {kind:'stat'}) instead of a string key, the validator at routers/admin_widgets.py:225 does `layout not in LAYOUT_KEYS` which raises TypeError on dict → returns 500 instead of 400. Self-inflicted in our first test run; fixed in tests. Worth a 2-line `isinstance(layout, str)` guard in _validate_editor_config for hardening.

CoinGecko's free-tier upstream limit (~30/min) is more aggressive than our local 60/min sliding window, so the structured local 429 body ({error:'rate_limit_exceeded',scope:'provider_burst',...}) is rarely observable from this preview egress. Code path inspected and matches spec; not a functional bug.

action_items: OPTIONAL hardening: guard `if layout and isinstance(layout, str) and layout not in LAYOUT_KEYS:` in admin_widgets._validate_editor_config — currently crashes 500 on layout=dict.

FYI: All 5 'skipped' tests in iter50 are CoinGecko-upstream-429 skips, not code defects; they pass when run in isolation after a 70-90s cooldown. Several of them DID pass in earlier runs of this same iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: utils/value_formatters.apply_formatter: correctly returns {raw,formatted,color}; positive/negative_color only applied for numeric formatters (percent/currency/number/compact); apply_formatters_dict skips fields with type='none' so the renderer cleanly falls back to mapped — good.

utils/sliding_window_rate_limit.rate_limit: real sliding window via deque + per-key asyncio.Lock + GC. retry_after computed from oldest entry. Persists denied events to db.rate_limit_events with TTL on expires_at — analytics endpoint reads it correctly. Robust.

services/api_widget_proxy._check_rate now uses sliding window for both provider-burst and per-widget burst; emits rl_meta surfaced as result['rate_limit'] for header injection — clean separation of concerns.
routers/api_widgets._set_rate_headers correctly emits all 3 X-RateLimit-* headers on 200 — verified present.
routers/api_widgets GET /admin/analytics/rate-limits: clamps hours to [1,168], gates on is_admin_user (support+stealth allowed, normal user 403). Shape matches spec.
routers/admin_widgets._validate_editor_config: lines 284-287 correctly enforce dict-shape on formatters + per-binding item_formatters with 400 — verified.
core/widget_templates.live_crypto / live_crypto_markets carry formatters / item_formatters preset — end-to-end api-call confirmed currency-formatted output.
